tasks.name: draft_contract
tasks.description:
Using the customs regulations research, credit risk assessment, and reviewed transaction data, draft a complete Sales Contract (國際銷售合約) in both English and Traditional Chinese (bilingual format).

SALES CONTRACT MANDATORY CLAUSES:
1. Full party identification and contact details (exporter and importer): company name, full address, registration number, tax ID, contact person title and name, phone, email, authorized representative name and title
2. Product specifications, quantity, unit price / total price with currency
3. HS Code and goods classification
4. Place of production: {place_of_production}
5. Incoterm clause with precise risk and cost transfer point
6. Port of discharge: {port_of_discharge}
7. Payment terms and method
8. Inspection and acceptance clause
9. Warranty and quality guarantee clause
10. Trademark ownership and licensing clause
11. Force majeure clause
12. Governing law and dispute resolution
13. Termination and remedies clause
14. Additional obligations of each party
15. Signature and execution block
16. All clauses required by customs regulations in the research
17. Any other remarks

DEFAULT VALUES — apply these when the corresponding input is blank or not provided:
- Warranty period: if blank → 12 months from date of delivery
- Inspection / claim period for visible defects: if blank → 14 calendar days after receipt
- Latent defect notification period: if blank → 6 months after discovery
- Cure period for material breach: if blank → 30 calendar days after written notice
- Cure period for payment default: if blank → 7 calendar days after written notice
- Force majeure termination trigger: if blank → 90 consecutive days
- Record retention period: if blank → 5 years after relevant shipment
- Number of arbitrators: if blank → 1 arbitrator for disputes under USD 500,000; 3 arbitrators for disputes of USD 500,000 or above
- Language of arbitration: if blank → English
- Controlling language of the bilingual contract: if blank → English
- CISG: if blank → expressly excluded
- Monetary liability cap: if blank → total contract price
- Negotiation period before arbitration: if blank → 30 calendar days after written notice of dispute

REQUIRES COMPLETION — mark only these when not provided:
- Exporter / importer legal name, address, registration number, tax ID, contact details, authorized representative name and title
- Product name, description, specifications
- Quantity and unit of measure
- Unit price, total price, currency
- HS Code
- Incoterm and named place or port
- Port of discharge
- Place of production
- Production date and delivery date
- Payment method, payment timing, bank details
- Trademark owner name, contact, and usage terms (if applicable)

=== CUSTOMS REGULATIONS ===
{customs_research}

=== CREDIT & INTEGRITY RISK ASSESSMENT ===
{credit_risk_assessment}

=== DATA REVIEW FINDINGS ===
{data_review}

=== TRANSACTION DATA ===
Exporter: {exporter_name}, {exporter_address} | Reg No: {exporter_reg_no} | Tax ID: {exporter_tax_id} | Contact: {exporter_contact_title} | Tel: {exporter_phone} | Email: {exporter_email} | Authorized Rep: {exporter_auth_rep} | Rep Title: {exporter_auth_rep_title}
Importer: {importer_name}, {importer_address} | Reg No: {importer_reg_no} | Tax ID: {importer_tax_id} | Contact: {importer_contact_title} | Tel: {importer_phone} | Email: {importer_email} | Authorized Rep: {importer_auth_rep} | Rep Title: {importer_auth_rep_title}
Product: {product_name} | Description: {product_description} | Qty: {product_qty} | Specs: {product_specs} | Packaging: {product_packaging} | Unit Price: {unit_price} | Total: {total_price} | Currency: {currency}
HS Code: {hs_code} | Incoterm: {incoterm} | Payment Method: {payment_method} | Payment Timing: {payment_timing} | Bank Details: {bank_details}
Place of Production: {place_of_production} | Port of Discharge: {port_of_discharge}
Production Date: {production_date} | Delivery Date: {delivery_date}
Warranty: {warranty_period} | Partial Shipment: {partial_shipment} | Inspection: {inspection} | Governing Law: {governing_law} | Dispute Resolution: {dispute_resolution}
Trademark Owner: {trademark_owner} | Trademark Owner Contact: {trademark_owner_contact} | Usage Terms: {trademark_usage}
Additional Obligations: {additional_obligations}
Other Remarks: {other_remarks}

tasks.name: compile_credit_risk_report
tasks.description:
Using the exporter investigation report and importer investigation report from the previous tasks, produce a comprehensive bilingual (English and Traditional Chinese) Credit and Integrity Risk Assessment Report.

The report must include:

## SECTION 1: EXPORTER CREDIT & INTEGRITY ASSESSMENT
### 1.1 Identity Verification Summary
### 1.2 Litigation & Legal Records
### 1.3 Regulatory & Compliance Records
### 1.4 Sanctions Screening Result
### 1.5 Financial Health Indicators
### 1.6 Negative News & Reputation
### 1.7 Exporter Risk Rating: LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / INSUFFICIENT DATA
### 1.8 Recommendations

## SECTION 2: IMPORTER CREDIT & INTEGRITY ASSESSMENT
### 2.1 Identity Verification Summary
### 2.2 Litigation & Legal Records
### 2.3 Regulatory & Compliance Records
### 2.4 Sanctions Screening Result
### 2.5 Financial Health Indicators
### 2.6 Negative News & Reputation
### 2.7 Importer Risk Rating: LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / INSUFFICIENT DATA
### 2.8 Recommendations

## SECTION 3: OVERALL TRANSACTION RISK VERDICT
### 3.1 Combined Risk Level: LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / INSUFFICIENT DATA
### 3.2 Key Risk Flags (if any)
### 3.3 Recommended Due Diligence Actions Before Signing

RULES:
- Base every finding strictly on the investigation data provided in the previous tasks.
- If investigation returned NO DATA for a party, state clearly: No adverse records found in the sources searched. Additional independent verification is recommended before proceeding.
- Never assign LOW risk solely because no data was found — use INSUFFICIENT DATA rating in that case.
- Never invent litigation records, violations or financial disputes.
- Write all section headings and content in both English and Traditional Chinese.
- INSUFFICIENT DATA means searches returned no results — it does not mean the party is clean.
tasks.expected_output: A complete bilingual Credit and Integrity Risk Assessment Report with all 3 sections fully completed. Each subsection contains the finding and its Traditional Chinese translation. Risk ratings are clearly stated. Recommendations are specific and actionable. If investigation data was absent for any party, the report clearly states INSUFFICIENT DATA and recommends independent verification.
